CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.release_hold(p_token text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_busy(p_loc text, p_date date, p_token text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(s_min integer, e_min integer, mine boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select b.start_min, b.end_min,
         coalesce(p_token is not null and b.token = p_token, false)
  from bookings b
  where b.loc_id = p_loc
    and b.date   = p_date
    and b.status = 'confirmed'
    and (b.kind <> 'hold' or b.expires_at > now());
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.confirm_booking(p_token text, p_ref text, p_loc_name text, p_service_id text, p_service_name text, p_price integer, p_name text, p_phone text, p_notes text, p_source text DEFAULT 'online'::text, p_created_by text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare hit int;
begin
  if p_name is null or length(trim(p_name)) < 2 then return 'badname'; end if;
  if p_phone !~ '^[6-9][0-9]{9}$'                then return 'badphone'; end if;
  if p_price < 0 or p_price > 50000              then return 'badprice'; end if;

  update bookings set
    kind         = 'booking',
    ref          = left(p_ref, 20),
    loc_name     = left(coalesce(p_loc_name, ''), 80),
    service_id   = left(coalesce(p_service_id, ''), 20),
    service_name = left(coalesce(p_service_name, ''), 120),
    price        = p_price,
    name         = left(trim(p_name), 80),
    phone        = p_phone,
    notes        = left(coalesce(nullif(trim(p_notes), ''), 'None'), 500),
    source       = case when p_source in ('online','phone','walkin')
                        then p_source else 'online' end,
    created_by   = left(coalesce(p_created_by, ''), 80),
    token        = null,
    expires_at   = null
  where token = p_token and kind = 'hold' and expires_at > now();

  get diagnostics hit = row_count;
  return case when hit = 1 then 'ok' else 'expired' end;
end $function$
